summary: Preinstall dropper fetches Bun runtime to execute obfuscated sibling payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which auto-executes on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is obfuscated (hex-prefixed identifiers, inline string-lookup objects like `_0x5f1571.SBBJg="bun"`) and, when `bun` is not already on PATH, downloads the Bun runtime archive from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<ver>/<platform>.zip` to a temp directory, unzips it, chmods 0755, and invokes the freshly-fetched Bun binary to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB single-line obfuscator.io-style payload with a shuffled constant array and rotator function, prefixed with `// @bun @bun-cjs`. The advertised purpose in package.json is a React legacy CSS repo config pointing to github.com/ornikar/shared-configs, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime nor for a large obfuscated payload; the shipped contents do not match the file layout that repo publishes, consistent with a hijack or squat of the scoped name. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern is used specifically to execute code with a runtime that Node-oriented scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
